reasoning_traces.think:
The core failure mode in 2p0s differentials is the exponential explosion of the game tree U^(2K) when both players have continuous actions (U→∞). We prove that information asymmetry reduces this to IK for the informed player (P1) and (I+1)K for the uninformed player (P2). This stems from the atomic support of equilibrium strategies: P1 uses at most I pure policies, each active on a subset of the state space, while P2 uses at most I+1. The reduction arises because P1 can pre-commit to type-contingent controls that satisfy Isaacs' condition, eliminating redundant mixed-strategy combinations. In NFL football, this explains why offenses conceal play type until a critical moment, reducing the effective branching factor from continuous action spaces to a small number of atomic strategies.
